# 00000005945

**KZ2-25 ★** — source: 183_KPZII.md

**English.** Definition: The three-exponent scaling is the exponent relation of rough time and space. Conjecture: The explicit joint of the three exponents is generated by a single space-time ratio, and the kernel of the generation is scale invariance. (scale-invariant joint space-time ratio of three exponents)

**中文。** 定义：三指数标度指粗糙时间空间的指数关系。猜想：三指数的联立显式由单一空时比生成；且生成的核为标度不变性。（三指数标度不变空时比联立）
